top.title: U.S. Stocks Slide as AI Bust Continues Despite Anthropic IPO
top.summary: U.S. stocks ended lower in a volatile session as Anthropic’s record-breaking initial public offering failed to staunch the bleeding in artificial-intelligence stocks.

top.title: Gold Falls, Weighed by Elevated Yields, Strong Dollar
top.summary: Gold declined in Asian trade. Elevated Treasury yields and a strong dollar are raising the cost of holding the nonyielding yellow metal, said Critical Metals.

top.title: Anthropic’s Mega IPO Lives Up to Wall Street Hype but Fails to Revive AI Trade
top.summary: Investors remained wary of tech and AI stocks, as the Nasdaq composite resumed its recent slide, dropping 2.3% on Thursday.

top.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
top.summary: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

top.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
top.summary: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

top.title: Nikkei Falls 2.9%, Dragged by Chip, Metals Stocks
top.summary: Japanese stocks were lower after Anthropic’s listing failed to boost major U.S. stock indexes overnight.

top.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
top.summary: SoftBank shares plunged over 16% on Friday as Japanese and South Korean technology stocks fell sharply.
